q: Rényi's entropy H_α(X) → H_∞(X) = −log max_x p(x) as α → ∞. This min-entropy equals:
opts: The negative log of the largest probability (the most likely outcome's surprisal)
exp: Min-entropy H_∞(X) = −log max_x p(x) is the entropy of the best single-guess predictor. It is the most conservative (smallest) Rényi entropy and equals 0 for a deterministic X. In cryptography it measures the one-query distinguishing advantage.
